cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth between January 1, 2019 and July 31, 2022 at Mugla University Education and Research Hospital.
finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 64.98%, with Robson groups 9, 5, 7, and 8 having the highest rates (100%, 99.34%, 97.56%, and 96.92% respectively) and group 3 having the lowest rate (21.5%).
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates varied significantly by Robson classification.
